mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a tighter monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% at decision date and 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% over the past month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% at decision date and 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 1350 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 720000 indicate a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1350 AND RSAFS < 720000 at decision date and 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 320), a federal funds rate above 4.0% (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) indicates aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 320 AND FEDFUNDS > 4.0% at decision date and 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong economic output, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 at decision date and 60-day forward returns are positive in <40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1350 indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which dampens overall economic activity and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1350 at decision date and 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 159000), strong employment conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% AND PAYEMS > 159000 at decision date and 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals elevated inflation, which reduces real corporate earnings and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 320 at decision date and 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.
